m.t: Meu pai acha que ele está sempre certo.
m.e: My father thinks that he's always right.

m.t: Mas como acha ele que eu me sinto?
m.e: But how does he think I feel?

m.t: Você acha que preciso fazer isso outra vez?
m.e: Do you think I need to do that again?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8065648 by MacGyver; English translation #6345941 by CK

m.t: Tu achas que preciso fazer isso outra vez?
m.e: Do you think I need to do that again?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8065646 by MacGyver; English translation #6345941 by CK

m.t: Achas que ele tem a ver com o caso?
m.e: Why, you think he has something to do with the case?

m.t: Acho que nos estamos a dar bem, não achas?
m.e: Hey, I think we're vibing right now, right, Pop? You feel it?

m.t: Achei que isso fosse chamar a tua atenção.
m.e: I thought that would get your attention.

m.t: Eu não achei que você fosse comer isso.
m.e: I didn't think you'd eat that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7262427 by Ricardo14; English translation #6351655 by CK

m.t: Achei que você gostaria de tomar um café da manhã.
m.e: I thought you might like some breakfast.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10788327 by megamanenm; English translation #10788323 by megamanenm

m.t: Podes achar que esta história não é real.
m.e: You might not think this story's true.

m.t: Eu acho que posso achar a sua casa.
m.e: I think that I can find your house.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8290521 by JGEN; English translation #8276972 by CK

m.t: Pode achar que a nossa organização trabalha um pouco... de maneira diferente.
m.e: Is there a contract... you may find that our organization does things a bit... Differently.

m.t: Acham que lhes conseguimos resolver todos os seus problemas.
m.e: They think we can solve all their problems.

m.t: Vocês acham que eu estou velho demais para ter outro filho?
m.e: Do you think I'm too old to have another baby?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2139496 by alexmarcelo; English translation #953228 by CK

m.t: O que acham de comida chinesa para o jantar?
m.e: How do you feel about Chinese food for dinner?

m.t: A minha mãe achou que seria uma boa ideia.
m.e: My mother thought it was a good idea.

m.t: Por que o senhor achou que tinha que fazer isso?
m.e: Why did you think you had to do that?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8061826 by MacGyver; English translation #6702234 by CK

m.t: "Ela está morta?" O que achou disso?
m.e: "Is she dead?" What did you make of that?

m.t: Achamos que você está indo muito bem aqui.
m.e: We think that you're doing very well here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8327788 by JGEN; English translation #8326164 by CK

m.t: Nós dois achamos que você poderia fazer isso.
m.e: We both thought you could do that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12317036 by Advanced; English translation #6334831 by CK

m.t: Você não achava que eu podia fazer isso, achava?
m.e: You didn't think I could do that, did you?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8926939 by Ricardo14; English translation #6239973 by CK

m.t: Achava que podia confiar nas pessoas, em tudo, mas nada tem valor.
m.e: You know, every... everyone I thought I could count on, everything, it doesn't matter.

m.t: Tom me disse o que achava do meu plano.
m.e: Tom told me what he thought of my plan.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5270028 by ToinhoAlam; English translation #3734752 by CK

m.t: Eles não acharam que eu era maluca ou algo assim.
m.e: They didn't think I was crazy or anything.

m.t: Todas as pessoas com quem falei acharam o mesmo.
m.e: Everyone I talked to thinks the same.

m.t: Digam-me o que acharam do filme que viram ontem.
m.e: Tell me what you think of the movie you saw yesterday.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10979683 by carlosalberto; English translation #10979653 by carlosalberto

m.t: Embora ache que não é bem o nosso estilo.
m.e: I don't think it fits for us though.

m.t: "Há por aqui algum tipo de droga que ache..." "Que podemos libertar"
m.e: Uh, there's some dope here that I think that we should liberate."

m.t: Achaste mesmo que havia uma cura... para isso?
m.e: Did you really think there was a cure... for that?

m.t: Porque achaste que era esta a casa dela?
m.e: Why would you think this was her house?

m.t: Por que você está achando que foi isso que causou o incêndio?
m.e: What makes you think that's what caused the fire?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3001613 by carlosalberto; English translation #3001593 by CK

m.t: Achando que não há lugar para ele fora destas paredes.
m.e: Thinking there ain't no place for 'em outside these walls.

m.t: O que você está achando do seu novo emprego?
m.e: How do you like your new job?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1052979 by brauliobezerra; English translation #269161 by CK

m.t: Outras crianças achavam que o mundo era só felicidade.
m.e: Like other kids thought the world was all happy.

m.t: Só o fizeram porque tinham medo do que achavam que ele pudesse fazer.
m.e: You killed him because you were scared of what you thought he might do.

m.t: Eu tenho certeza de que você está certa.
m.e: I am sure you are right.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2836443 by alexmarcelo; English translation #3601187 by Shady_arc

m.t: A verdade é que ela estava certa sobre mim.
m.e: Thing is, she was right about me.

m.t: Eu sei, só temos de encontrar a altura certa.
m.e: We just have to find the right time.

m.t: Essa não é a maneira certa de fazer isso.
m.e: That's just not the right way to do that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8288171 by JGEN; English translation #8282362 by CK

m.e: Are you sure that's the right word?

m.t: Eu acho que você fez a coisa certa.
m.e: I think you did the right thing.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5905984 by bill; English translation #2408530 by CK

m.e: If you have anything to say, now is the time.

m.e: I know I'm doing the right thing.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5900593 by bill; English translation #3619007 by CK

m.e: Are you sure you're in the right street?

m.e: You'd better be right about this.

m.e: I can't find the right woman for me.

m.e: So anything you do, anything at all, you're doing for the right reason.

m.t: Pensava que era a coisa certa. Só por isso a fiz.
m.e: I thought it was the right thing, that's the only reason I did it.

m.t: Ela fez a decisão certa no momento certo.
m.e: She made the right decision at the right time.

m.e: I know you'll do the right thing.

m.e: You know, at some point, I'm gonna have to start walking home on my own.

m.t: Gostava de começar do zero e, dessa vez, fazer as coisas certas.
m.e: Wish I could start from scratch. Just get it right this time.

m.t: Você só tem de encontrar as palavras certas.
m.e: You just need to find the right words.

m.t: Vocês só precisam encontrar as palavras certas.
m.e: You just need to find the right words.

m.e: Honestly, I can't understand certain things and I think I never will.

m.e: I really appreciate all your help.

m.e: Second, his blood was found inside the vehicle, but only in a few areas.

m.t: No liceu, certas miúdas nunca souberam o nome dele.
m.e: There were girls in high school that never knew his real name.

m.t: Então, algumas pessoas exigem, como sabe, certas coisas.
m.e: So certain people require, you know, certain things.

m.t: Algumas coisas não são sustentáveis para certas pessoas.
m.e: Some of those things are not sustainable for some people.

m.t: Certas coisas continuam a incomodar-me, por isso voltei para investigar.
m.e: Why are you in Paulie? A few things were still bothering me, so I came back to investigate.

m.e: He has made certain decisions that have distanced him from me, and this family.

m.t: Não acho que estejam certos, só que têm o direito à sua opinião.
m.e: Look, I'm not saying they're right. I'm saying they have a right to their opinion.

m.t: Eu só não escolhi os números certos, mas escolhi a miúda certa.
m.e: I just didn't pick the right numbers... but I picked the right girl.

m.e: No, the landmarks on the map have all been right so far.

m.t: A verdade é que... não tenho os documentos certos para sair esta noite.
m.e: Truth is... I don't have the right papers to be out tonight.

m.e: Now, Father thinks she's willing to drop it given the right favors in return.

m.e: You had it right the first time.
